about: Talk key asks to sort by whether they'd watch it: `here` asks (being taught, a recipe, a paper explained, a plan, and "do it here") want a note opened beside them and written as it goes (open with new, then edit), never a handoff; `away` asks (code, big research, and "in the background") want a handoff. A `live` ask (a quick tweak to the page in front of them) wants it changed there by a tool, the lasting fix handed off; with no tool that changes it, a handoff that says it can't be done live yet. Jobs are refused here (jobs_never), so a handoff is only tried. tools/evals/summoned.ts --fixture companion/summoned-together.json --models sonnet runs them.

Sparse Lighthouse Routing for Long-Context Models
Alice Park, Bob Lee
Abstract
We route each token to a small set of beacon tokens chosen by a learned score, so attention cost grows with the number of beacons rather than the context. On three long-document benchmarks it matches dense attention at a fifth of the compute.
